title: 以军再度空袭加沙医院
summary: 当地卫生部门称6名遇难者包括一名医生、几名患者及陪同人员。以军称袭击目标是藏匿于纳赛尔医院的哈马斯汗尤尼斯旅指挥官及其他武装人员。

title: Iran targets US military base in Bahrain with drone attack
summary: It marks the second attack on the country in three days and comes as the US and Iran remain locked in a stand-off over the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Israel kills Hamas commander in strike on Gaza camp, officials say
summary: Both Hamas and IDF officials confirm the death of Samir Abu Younis, commander of the Rafah Brigade.
